sections.overall: A quieter week this week - reflected in generally fewer votes from fans across the board. Best match of the week was Jon Moxley vs Jack Perry, which main-evented Dynamite. With All In fast approaching, hopefully AEW will prioritise build for the exciting matches they have confirmed.
sections.mens: Konosuke Takeshita drops out of the rankings this week from his #4 spot, though expect him back in a couple of weeks for All In. Another decent match this week was Nigel McGuinness vs Katsuyori Shibata on Collision: the highest-rated match of the first round Continental Cup Challenge.
sections.womens: Mercedes Mone vs Zayda Steel didn't deliver as much as we hoped, though it was great to see Zayda given the spotlight. We've been lacking a strong Women's match for several weeks now.
sections.menstag: Again, no Men's Tag matches this week, with Brodido the only consistent team featured within the Trios.
sections.womenstag: Similar to last week, with a swap of partners from Hyan to Thunder Rosa. A fairly average match, mostly used to build the TBS 4 Way. Divine Dominion featured but only in a squash, which being 5 muinutes, is not eligible for the EWR system.
sections.trios: The new champs, Brodio & Page successfully defended against The Lethal Twist in a decent Collision opener. There is finally some buzz around the Trios Division, despite the hot-potatoing of the title.
